svg.title: Whalelet Sanctuary — An open-water whale-song amphitheater on moored decks
svg.desc: A broad amphitheater faces the whalelets’ open water. Dry recording decks, resonance stakes and a sheltered instrument balcony create an aid loop around the current.
svg.text: An open-water whale-song amphitheater on moored decks
Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 31–35
A broad amphitheater faces the whalelets’ open water. Dry recording decks, resonance stakes and a sheltered
instrument balcony create an aid loop around the current.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
Reefsong Whalelet · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
